note: Only complete runs on full datasets are ranked. Scores are means over items with a 95% bootstrap interval. Runs on public samples are never ranked and are not comparable with full-set runs. Explanation scores are judge-marked, not human-validated, and shown only for runs that used the current judge pair. This is the archived v1 leaderboard: 7 tests, 3 epochs, provider-default reasoning, 2,260 items. It is not comparable with v2.
